tests.description: DW84-API-001: real Nuuk +1 helper output is created by the owner and read by the partner with literal March 28 response assertions.

summary: Generated one P1 API integration case in the approved coverage plan. It uses merged fixtures, real worker-pair auth, Zod projection validation, apiRequest for every HTTP operation, no retry on non-idempotent INSERT, and literal 2026-03-28 expectations at POST and partner GET. Arithmetic and error matrices remain with existing coverage; no new API rejection behavior changed. No tests run and no real test/fixture files written. Pact artifacts are out of scope; broker tools were unavailable per parent probe, with provider source used as evidence.
